name: Alex Mercer

experiences.description: Automated deployment infrastructure using GitHub Actions pipelines, reducing delivery cycle times by 20%. Managed scalable Docker containers within development cluster environments.

projects.title: Automated Portfolio Generator
projects.description: A dynamic portfolio generator that creates personalized portfolios based on user input, showcasing skills, experiences, and projects in a visually appealing format.
projects.methodology: Designed and implemented a full-stack application that integrates with GitHub for seamless deployment, utilizing CI/CD pipelines to automate the build and deployment process.
projects.infrastructure: Deployed on AWS using Elastic Beanstalk, ensuring scalability and reliability for users accessing their generated portfolios.

projects.title: Cloud Resource Manager
projects.description: A tool designed to help developers manage and optimize their cloud resources across multiple providers, providing insights and automation for cost savings.
projects.methodology: Implemented a command-line interface that interacts with cloud provider APIs to fetch resource usage data, analyze costs, and suggest optimizations.
projects.infrastructure: Hosted on AWS Lambda for serverless execution, allowing users to run the tool without managing infrastructure.
